gaps.lead: Fewer students enrolled this year than we expected.
gaps.explanation: fewer than expected = not as many (students) as expected.

gaps.lead: He no longer thinks he can find a job before the end of the year.
gaps.sentence: He has given ___ a job before the end of the year.
gaps.explanation: 'No longer thinks he can find' becomes 'has given up hope of finding'.

gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.

gaps.answer: No sooner had he been elected
gaps.lead: He was elected, and he broke his first promise immediately.
gaps.sentence: ___ than he broke his first promise.
gaps.explanation: Passive inversion: No sooner had he been elected than…

gaps.lead: The suitcase was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective + that → such (+a) + adjective + noun + that.
